structure.raw_text:
Here is the transcription of the document:

**# Collateral Stuff**

We take collateral for loans and trades. People should check the things and make sure they look good. Sometimes we ask legal if it's okay. Most of the time it's fine.

We mostly do bonds and stocks but sometimes other things. If something is risky then maybe apply a discount. The desk decides what works. There is no need to write everything down because people know what to do.

Exceptions happen but usually we just do it. Reporting is ad hoc and only done when someone asks. There is no formal monitoring, and roles are not really defined.

Purpose and Scope

1.1 Purpose
The purpose of this Collateral Management Policy is to establish guidelines and requirements for the management of collateral taken for loans and trades within the organization.

1.2 Scope
This policy applies to all employees involved in the collateral management process, including those in the loans, trading, and legal departments. It covers the acceptance, valuation, and monitoring of all types of collateral, including bonds, stocks, and other assets.

3. Policy Statement

3.1 General Principles
All collateral taken by the organization must be properly evaluated and discounted based on the level of risk. The collateral desk is responsible for determining the appropriate valuation and discount rates for each asset type.

3.2 Specific Requirements
Employees must document the collateral acceptance and valuation process for each transaction. Legal review is required for any non-standard or high-risk collateral items.

template_improvements.improved:
4. Roles and Responsibilities

4.1 Management
Management is responsible for overseeing the collateral management process and ensuring compliance with this policy. They must approve any exceptions to the standard collateral requirements.

4.2 Staff
All employees involved in collateral acceptance, valuation, and monitoring are responsible for following the procedures outlined in this policy. They must report any issues or exceptions to management.

5. Procedures and Controls

5.1 Implementation Procedures
Detailed procedures for collateral acceptance, valuation, and monitoring will be documented and communicated to all relevant staff.

5.2 Control Mechanisms
Regular audits and reviews of the collateral management process will be conducted to ensure compliance and identify any areas for improvement.
